verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU Mulokozi wange
Leero nze wuwo wekka;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Tukutendereza,Yesu:
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Nkwebaza,Mulokozi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Edda nafyba bufubi
Okufuna-emirembe;
Leero mmaliridde ddala,
Okweyabiza Yesu.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Tukutendereza,Yesu:
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Nkwebaza,Mulokozi.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Nnaababuuliranga-abantu
Obulokozi bwonna,
Obutali bwa kitundu
Obulamba-ob'obuwa.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Tukutendereza,Yesu:
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Nkwebaza,Mulokozi.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Nnaategeezanga-ebya Yesu
N'obuvuumu ne sitya;
Eyanzigya mu busibe
N'okuwonya-eyamponya.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Tukutendereza,Yesu:
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Nkwebaza,Mulokozi.

verse.name: v9
verse.lines:
Neebaza-eyannunula nze;
Eyamponya wa kisa!
Yesu-ankuuma ansanyusa-era,
Bulijjo yeebazibwe.

verse.name: v10
verse.lines:
Tukutendereza,Yesu:
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Nkwebaza,Mulokozi.
